tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The calm, warm-paper ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands, product image wells, footer.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the cart drawer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card and input borders (decorative).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders that must be seen (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on any surface. Light value is the charcoal of the AF monogram.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, on any surface.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Brand red from the wordmark. Primary buttons, links, sale price; as text on surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised.

tokens.name: crimson-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of crimson; the maroon from the monogram gradient.

tokens.name: crimson-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind crimson text: promo strips, selected filters.

tokens.name: swoosh
tokens.usage: Burnt orange from the logo swoosh. Small accents: rules under eyebrows, active tab underline, rating stars. Darkened from the logo's #bb430a so it also passes as text on every surface.

tokens.name: swoosh-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tint for the 'craftsmanship' and material callout panels.

tokens.name: on-crimson
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a crimson fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: In stock, order confirmed. As text on any surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, offset 2px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Product names on cards, card titles.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above section titles, in ink-muted, with a swoosh rule.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Every piece is built in our Dhaka workshop from seasoned wood.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Free delivery inside Dhaka on orders above ৳ 20,000.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Specs, helper text, metadata, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: price under product name.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap between product cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, space between heading and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections. Calm needs room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, image wells.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter pills and quantity steppers only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Hovered product card and the cart drawer. Resting cards use a line border, not a shadow.

web.note: Website additions on top of the Akhi Furniture design system. CSS source of truth: assets/tokens.css

fonts.hosting: self-hosted woff2 via Fontsource, latin + bengali subsets, font-display: swap

bengaliType.rule: about 12% larger, taller line height, no uppercase, no letter-spacing
bengaliType.label: 15px / 22px
bengaliType.caption: 14px / 22px

web.darkBands: class .theme-dark applies the design system's dark values to a band (workshop, business hero, dark CTA)
